title: sonic-playground track (front matter of content/<artist>-<track>.md)
description: The one contract of a track review. scripts/catalog.py validates every article against it, scripts/track.py writes new ones from it, and the templates read only what it allows. The file name is the slug of 'artist track': the artist comes first, which is what artist inference relies on. Since v2 (ADR 0004) every review is also an educational article: the concepts it teaches, a timed listening guide, discussion questions, cited sources, credits and stable identifiers (MusicBrainz, Wikidata, ISRC) live in the front matter, so pages, projections and links are derived from them.

title.description: 'Artist - Track' (preferred) or 'Track | Artist'; scripts/catalog.py infers both parts from it.

description.description: One or two sentences: the vibe of the track. Used as lead, card text, meta and feed summary.

draft.description: true keeps the article out of the catalogue and the site.

genre.description: Genres, most specific last; reuse the existing vocabulary (scripts/track.py vocab).

concept.description: Musical, technical or cultural concepts the track demonstrates; each one is defined in data/concepts/<slug>.toml (term, category, definitions in every locale) and gets a page that explains it and lists every track that shows it.

instrument.description: Instruments and sound sources you can hear ("drum machine", "vocoder", "cello").

youtube.description: The video as an embed URL; the site plays it through youtube-nocookie on demand.

cover_image.description: A local still under static/; without it the card uses the video's YouTube still.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the artist comes from (origin, not residence; MusicBrainz's area when no source says otherwise). One artist has one country across all reviews (scripts/catalog.py checks it).

bpm.description: Tempo in beats per minute, when sourced (a database or the artist).

key.description: Musical key, e.g. 'A minor', when sourced.

musicbrainz.description: MusicBrainz identifiers (scripts/track.py enrich): the recording, its artist and a release.

wikidata.description: Wikidata item of the recording or, failing that, of the work.

influences.description: Artists or styles the track draws on, named in sources or interviews.

samples.description: Recordings the track samples or interpolates.

why.description: What the two share, in one sentence.

connections.description: Curated links to other reviews, each with its reason (the derived related tracks come on top).

learning.description: The didactic layer: what a reader learns, where to listen, what to discuss.

objectives.description: After reading and listening, the reader can ... (one sentence each).

at.description: Time in the embedded video, m:ss; only when sourced (the video's chapters, a credible analysis). It seeks the player.

part.description: The part of the song ("intro", "first chorus", "the outro"); always possible without a stopwatch.

listen_for.description: A listening guide: each entry names a part of the song or a sourced time (the contract requires one of the two), and what to hear there.

questions.description: Questions for discussion or a class.

sources.description: The sources the review rests on, cited under References.

edu_exempt.description: Why this review cannot carry the educational layer (no source describes the track, the recording cannot be verified). An explicit, reviewed exception to x-sonic.edu_required, never a silent gap.

cliches: takes the listener on a journey

translation.description: ADR 0006: every page has its translation beside it (<name>.<lang>.md, scripts/translation.py). required: a missing one is an error. untranslated_marker: what translate.py scaffold leaves in each text. czech_word_ratio: the share of words with Czech diacritics a Czech text has at least. min_words_ratio: a translation has at least this share of the English page's words.
